title: JavaScript security bug hunts
description: Larkspur Letterpress is a two-press print studio whose customer portal grew over a few weekends without anyone asking what an unfriendly user might type. As its new developer you work through five tickets, each a security hole in ordinary code: prove it, close it at the cause, and write the test that keeps it closed. You learn to pass values apart from queries, escape what goes into a page, check who owns what, keep file names inside their folder and keep secrets out of logs.

parts.title: Data that reaches the wrong person
